title: Egyptian Pickle Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and tangy stir fry dish infused with Egyptian spices and crunchy pickles. Serve as a side or add to your meal for a burst of flavor.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the thinly sliced pickles, chopped fresh dill, and cooked onion mixture to the skillet.
In a small bowl, whisk together the velvety tahini paste, sour lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the tahini sauce over the pickle mixture and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve hot over rice or as a side dish.
